findings.claim: The DISPATCH-NOTE Files section (5 entries) and Slice acceptance checklist (5 items) were not updated after fix-round-1 added material changes to docs/adoption/ADOPT-001-project-onboarding.md. The file does not appear in the Files list, and no checklist item covers '(vi) ADOPT-001 §12.7 supply-chain disclosure updated'. The fix-round-1 closed COMP-MAJ-001 by rewriting §12.7.1, §12.7.9, and §12.7.13 — a substantive slice-scope expansion — but the DISPATCH-NOTE audit trail was only partially updated (the 'Post-merge STATUS.md update' section was rewritten per COMP-MIN-002, but the Files and acceptance sections were not).
findings.evidence: DISPATCH-NOTE Files section (lines 129–135) lists exactly five files: scripts/.tool-versions, scripts/scp-policy-check.lock, .github/workflows/policy-check.yml, STATUS.md, docs/reviews/WP-SCP-022/dispatches/020h2/DISPATCH-NOTE.md. docs/adoption/ADOPT-001-project-onboarding.md is absent. Acceptance checklist has items (i)–(v) only. FIX-ROUND-1.md closure table row 'SAFE-001 + COMP-MAJ-001' explicitly documents ADOPT-001 §12.7.1, §12.7.9, §12.7.13 as changed. Actual ADOPT-001 diff confirmed: §12.7.1 (line 794) now reads 'Regal SHA256-verified per platform' (not 'including the known Regal SHA256 verification gap (TF-020H3-001)'); §12.7.9 (line 998) now reads 'IS SHA256-verified as of slice 020H.2'; §12.7.13 retitled 'Supply-chain posture (post-020H.2)', fork-guidance paragraph removed, Regal bullet updated with TF-020H3-001 closure mark.
findings.impact: A future maintainer auditing the slice using only the DISPATCH-NOTE's Files list and acceptance checklist will not know that ADOPT-001 was changed. The audit trail for the slice is structurally incomplete: FIX-ROUND-1.md records the change but the authoritative DISPATCH-NOTE does not. This matters for estate-cascade adopters (FLA, PIM, recommender, shopify-app, mapp-doc-agent, control-tower per WP-SCP-024) whose onboarding reviews will reference this DISPATCH-NOTE as the canonical scope record. The gap also means the acceptance checklist cannot be mechanically satisfied — item (vi) does not exist to be checked.
findings.mitigation: Add docs/adoption/ADOPT-001-project-onboarding.md to the DISPATCH-NOTE Files section. Add a checklist item '(vi) ADOPT-001 §12.7 supply-chain disclosure updated: §12.7.1 drops TF-020H3-001 gap reference; §12.7.9 updated to IS SHA256-verified; §12.7.13 retitled post-020H.2, fork-guidance paragraph removed, TF-020H3-001 closure mark added' and check it. Both changes are one-line additions to the DISPATCH-NOTE; no code or logic changes required.
